task_list.name: Threshold Segmentation
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Segment cells darker than the background using Gaussian smoothing, automatic (Yen) thresholding, hole filling & size filtering.

### Outputs
- A label image

mode.description: The mode to use for channel selection. Can be "label", "wavelength_id", or "index".
mode.title: Mode

identifier.description:
The identifier for the channel selection. The interpretation of this field depends
on the mode:
- If mode is "label", this should be the channel label.
- If mode is "wavelength_id", this should be the wavelength ID of the channel.
- If mode is "index", this should be the index of the channel (must be an integer).
identifier.title: Identifier

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Select the input channel to be used for segmentation. Defaults to the "LightLoss_Imaging" channel.

label_name.title: Label Name
label_name.description: Name of the resulting label image. If not provided, it will be set to "<channel_identifier>_thresholded".

sigma.title: Sigma
sigma.description: Standard deviation of the Gaussian smoothing along (y, x).

max_size.title: Max Size
max_size.description: Objects with this many pixels or fewer are removed.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing label image. Defaults to True.

task_list.name: Label to Event
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Link the labels of an existing label image (e.g. from a segmentation task of another package) to their FCS events.
- Each label must lie entirely within a single FOV of the "FOV_ROI_table".

### Outputs
- A "<label_name>_to_event" feature table mapping each label to its FCS event ("event_index" column)

label_name.title: Label Name
label_name.description: Name of the existing label image.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing label to event table. Defaults to True.

task_list.name: Chunk ROI Table
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Build an ROI table whose ROIs cover whole chunks of the image, or whole shards if the image is sharded.
- Useful to run tasks that iterate over ROI tables, but have no direct per chunk access, chunk by chunk.
- Each ROI covers an n x n grid of chunks/shards along y and x; ROIs at the image edge are clipped to the image.
- Only the highest resolution level is considered.

### Outputs
- An ROI table with one ROI per n x n grid of chunks/shards, named "chunk_ROI_table_{n}x{n}" ("shard_ROI_table_{n}x{n}" if the image is sharded) unless a table name is given

chunks_per_roi_side.title: Chunks Per Roi Side
chunks_per_roi_side.description: Number of chunks (or shards) per ROI side along y and x, e.g. 2 means each ROI covers a 2 x 2 grid of chunks. Defaults to 1.

table_name.title: Table Name
table_name.description: Name of the ROI table. If None, it is "chunk_ROI_table_{n}x{n}", or "shard_ROI_table_{n}x{n}" if the image is sharded, with n = chunks_per_roi_side. Defaults to None.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing table. Defaults to True.

task_list.name: Invert Channel
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Invert one channel of the mosaic image, selected by label, and add it as a new channel "<label>_inv", so that objects darker than the background become bright.
- The channel is inverted around its background c as max(0, c - x). c is the median of the channel over the FOVs, leaving out the padding between FOVs.
- Only the FOVs of the "FOV_ROI_table" are inverted; the padding between FOVs stays 0.

### Outputs
- The input image, rewritten in place with the extra "<label>_inv" channel; labels, tables and FCS metadata are kept

channel_label.title: Channel Label
channel_label.description: Label of the channel to invert.

task_list.name: FCF BD Converter
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Convert data from BD S8 and A8 Flow Cytometers (TIFF files) to OME-Zarr format.
- Supports TIFFs extracted with the standalone BD image extractor or the FlowJo plugin.
- Optionally store the event data of the matching FCS file as a feature table, and its
  TEXT keywords as a JSON file.

### Outputs
- A single mosaic OME-Zarr file containing all converted images. Optionally in plate format
- Images are stored as float32, or optionally as uint16 (values clipped to [0, 8] and
  scaled to the full uint16 range)
- If an FCS file is provided, an "fcs_events" feature table with the raw values of all
  events, indexed by "event_index" (matching the FOV ROI names), and a "fcs_metadata.json"
  file next to the image "zarr.json" with all FCS TEXT keywords under "fcs_text".

### Limitations
- POC implementation, only tested on one S8 and one A8 dataset
- FCS values are stored as float32, integer parameters need to be reinterpreted

zarr_dir.title: Zarr Dir
zarr_dir.description: path of the directory where the new OME-Zarrs will be created. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

input_path.title: Input Path
input_path.description: Path to the BD S8 or A8 recording to convert. Either a folder containing the exported TIFF files, or a `.cvw` waveform file. With a `.cvw` file, the pixel size is the one of the vendor TIFF exports.

fcs_file_path.title: Fcs File Path
fcs_file_path.description: Path to the FCS file of the same recording. If provided, all its events are saved as the "fcs_events" feature table, with the raw values of all parameters and an "event_index" column matching the names of the ROIs in "FOV_ROI_table". Values are stored as float32, so integer parameters show up as meaningless floats until reinterpreted (e.g. with `.view(np.uint32)`). All its TEXT keywords are saved under "fcs_text" in a "fcs_metadata.json" file next to the image "zarr.json". Keywords are lowercased and without the leading "$" (as read by flowio); values are the unchanged strings.

zarr_name.title: Zarr Name
zarr_name.description: Name of the output OME-Zarr, without the ".ome.zarr" extension. Used for the plate if `fake_a_plate` is True, otherwise for the image. If None, the name of the TIFF folder or of the `.cvw` file (without extension) is used, with special characters (e.g. whitespace, "#", parentheses) replaced by underscores.

fake_a_plate.title: Fake A Plate
fake_a_plate.description: Whether to create a fake plate structure with a single well "A01" containing the mosaic image. This is useful to use some tools that need plates (e.g. Fractal feature explorer). Defaults to True.

add_z_singleton.title: Add Z Singleton
add_z_singleton.description: Whether to add a singleton Z dimension to the OME-Zarr. This is useful to use some of the tools (like the Fractal feature explorer) that require Z singleton dimensions. Defaults to False.

use_sharding.title: Use Sharding
use_sharding.description: Whether to store the image in shards. If True, each chunk holds a single mosaic tile and shards are about `target_shard_size` pixels per side. If False, there is no sharding and chunks are about `target_chunk_size` pixels per side. Chunks and shards always hold all channels and a whole number of tiles. Defaults to False.

convert_to_uint16.title: Convert To Uint16
convert_to_uint16.description: Whether to store the image as uint16 instead of float32. Values are clipped to [0, 8] and scaled linearly to the full uint16 range [0, 65535]. Defaults to False.

target_chunk_size.title: Target Chunk Size
target_chunk_size.description: Target size in pixels of the chunks along y and x, used only without sharding. Rounded to the closest whole number of tiles (at least one). This parameter is ignored if `use_sharding` is True. Defaults to 512.

target_shard_size.title: Target Shard Size
target_shard_size.description: Target size in pixels of the shards along y and x, used only with sharding. Rounded to the closest whole number of tiles (at least one). This parameter is ignored if `use_sharding` is False. Defaults to 2048.

convert_first_n_events.title: Convert First N Events
convert_first_n_events.description: If provided, only the first N events are converted: the first N TIFF files of the folder, or the first N events of the `.cvw` file. This is useful for testing with fewer events. If None, all events are converted.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing OME-Zarr image (and fake plate, if `fake_a_plate` is True). Defaults to True.

task_list.name: Region Props Features
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Makes region properties measurements on label images and stores them in the OME-Zarr format.

### Outputs
- A measurements table in the OME-Zarr format.

label_image_name.title: Label Image Name
label_image_name.description: Name of the label image to analyze.

output_table_name.title: Output Table Name
output_table_name.description: Name for the output feature table.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing feature table. Defaults to True.
